name: Kaioken Verify
summary: Structural module for kaioken/verify, implementing a verification gate system that runs configured commands and reports pass/fail/unverifiable results. Includes package manager detection, command discovery from verify.json config, output parsing for test failures, and a repair protocol for iterative fixes.
keyPoints: GateCommand defines a single verification command; GateResult extends it with actual execution outcome.
Package managers supported: pnpm, yarn, bun, npm, deno; detection scans lockfiles or config files.
runGate orchestrates commands, collects outcomes, and builds a GateReport with overall verdict (passed/failed/unverifiable).
Output processing: stripAnsi removes ANSI escapes; extractFailures parses test failure indicators; formatFailureSummary summarizes failed tests for output.
REPAIR_PROTOCOL constant instructs agents to read failures, apply minimal fixes, re-run up to 5 times, and never weaken tests.
runVerify is the main entry point: reads config, detects commands, runs gate, returns {pass, summary}.
Tests use ScriptedRunner to simulate command outcomes and repo() to create temporary project fixtures.

entryPoints.name: runVerify
entryPoints.note: Main entry point: verifies a project root; returns pass boolean and summary string.

entryPoints.name: runGate
entryPoints.note: Executes a list of gate commands with a runner and returns a GateReport.

entryPoints.name: detectCommands
entryPoints.note: Detects verification commands from verify.json config or falls back to package manager defaults.

entryPoints.note: Identifies the package manager used in a project root.

entryPoints.note: Extracts and summarizes test failures from raw command output.
